question: In 2025-Table_3A_Supervisory_Severely_Adverse_Domestic.csv, find the quarter with the highest Unemployment rate; if tied, the earliest. Report the cumulative sum of Real GDP growth from the first row through that quarter inclusive (sum of the quarterly figures), rounded to 1 decimal.
solve_py:
import os, pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
a=pd.read_csv(D+'/2025-Table_3A_Supervisory_Severely_Adverse_Domestic.csv').reset_index(drop=True);i=a['Unemployment rate'].idxmax();print(round(a.loc[:i,'Real GDP growth'].sum(),1))
